messages:
Jamie L: Hey team — quick design review for the API Keys page. I pushed a small mock to Figma for the Rotate/Revoke flows. Can we sanity-check copy and keyboard flow?

Sasha P: saw it, thanks. main thing i noticed: the rotate modal feels long. we have 3 paragraphs of copy + checkbox about rolling updates. can we compress? :thinking:

Chris (PM): Agreed. Users care about two things: 1) will rotating break existing services, 2) can they undo. Propose a short lead + 2 lines of details hidden behind a "more info" link.

Jamie L: Proposed short copy: 
```
Rotate key — this will generate a new secret and disable the old one.
Services using the old key will stop working until updated. You can revoke the old key after you verify traffic.
```
Would that be ok?

Maria (A11y): shorter is better. For screen readers we should not use "more info" as a link alone; use aria-expanded on the button and include the heading in the reveal region. Also the modal title should be an h1 and programmatically focused when opened.

Sasha P: also: when we show the new key we currently render it as plain text with a "copy" button. We should add a visually-hidden label for screen readers e.g. `New key value, shown only once` and put `aria-live="polite"` on the success toast for copy.

Jamie L: good call. UX question: should the newly-created key show inline notes about scopes/roles, or link to the key details page? i worry clutter.

Chris (PM): link to details is fine for most users. But for create+copy flow (first-time create) we should show the scopes summary inline (two-line pill list), then "View full settings" link. Keep modal height small.

Sasha P: Another nit: revoke action currently sits in the top-right kebab. Users often expect a 'danger zone' at bottom of key details with clear CTA. Can we move revoke into a bottom-area with a red primary button and a secondary 'rotate' to the left?

Jamie L: I like that. But we need to preserve keyboard ordering: primary action should be last in DOM for right-to-left keyboards? also focus order must be logical (Confirm, Cancel).

Maria (A11y): Focus notes: when the revoke confirmation opens, trap focus in the dialog, focus the first interactive (checkbox that asks to confirm) then the primary revoke. Ensure `esc` closes. Provide `aria-describedby` referencing the consequences paragraph. Add a visible focus indicator on the show/hide secret toggle.

Sasha P: Copy tweak for revoke modal headline: currently "Revoke API key" -> maybe stronger: "Permanently revoke key" and subcopy: "This will immediately stop any clients using the key." short and clear.

Jamie L: love that. Also thinking about empty state for keys list — current mock shows a big illustration + a single CTA "Create key". Product asked if we should offer examples or templates (read-only embed key, server key). Thoughts?

Chris (PM): Offer two CTAs? that gets noisy. Maybe keep primary "Create key" and a small secondary text link "See example use cases" that opens a lightweight panel with 3 short examples. Keeps onboarding light but discoverable.

Sasha P: +1. For the create flow, add a small microcopy under the name input about naming conventions (e.g., "use service name - env"), and show a character limit counter. people often create generic names.

Maria (A11y): Character counter should be `aria-live="polite"` on change so SR users know remaining chars. Also ensure the name input has `autocomplete="off"` if we want to avoid password managers interfering.

Jamie L: One more: rotate grace period. Some customers want a window where both old+new keys work for N minutes to allow rollout. We currently have checkbox "Allow 30 minute overlap". UX/wording?

Chris (PM): call it "Enable overlap window (30 min)" with tooltip explaining the tradeoff: "Short overlap reduces downtime but increases risk if old key is compromised." Keep default off.

Sasha P: UI-wise the overlap toggle should be inline with a small help icon that opens a tooltip. And if enabled, show a small countdown on the key details page once rotation completes: "Overlap active — 29:59 remaining".

Maria (A11y): Tooltips need `role="tooltip"` and accessible dismissal. For the countdown, make sure it's not just visual: include `aria-live="polite"` updates or a textual fallback like "Overlap active — ends at 3:42pm" because auto-updating text can be noisy for SR users.

Jamie L: Great feedback. Action items: 
- Sasha: update Figma mock to collapse rotate copy and add inline scope pills + details link.
- Maria: post a short A11y checklist for these modals (focus, aria-expanded, labels, tooltip roles).
- Chris: draft the copy variants for rotate/revoke bullets and the empty state microcopy.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy to staging at 2026-03-24T17:00Z — will include the updated key page CSS changes.

Jamie L: Thanks all — i'll update the file and ping when ready for a follow-up review. :thumbsup:
